details: OSF deposit has no readme or data dictionary: StepTable holds AngMom_X/Y/Z per participant, step type, asymmetry bin and side with no statistic, normalisation or units stated, and the per-stride files hold unlabeled 3-column momentum arrays per step with no sampling rate, so the values cannot be tied to the paper (integrated whole-body angular momentum, normalised by mass, speed and height) with confidence.
